kinematics_source: models/armold-mks-concept-v1/kinematics.json (joint origins, world axes, R_child at the display pose) and parameters.json (lengths, reducer diameters/depth, motor/driver assumptions) - read only, never changed here (user 2026-10-27: URDF in preparation, do not touch joint distances)

tool.limits_note: 검토 MP9-B1: 구멍 깊이 ≤ flange_t − screw_hole_min_floor · 구멍이 돌기 밖(pcd/2 − d/2 > 돌기 반지름) · 모따기 안(pcd/2 + d/2 < flange_r − flange_chamfer) · 원장 재료 = 그리퍼 fits_from.material 을 생성기와 검사기가 따로 단언. 깊이의 원천인 그리퍼 screws.arm_m3.length 는 그리퍼 쪽 표기로 잠정(「length set when the arm side is designed」) — 나사 길이를 정하면 이 깊이도 바뀐다
tool.interface_note: MP9 2 단계(2026-10-28 · 계획 051): 옛 민트 고리(Ø40 × 4 · ring_r 20 · ring_t 4)를 그리퍼 규격 돌기로 바꿈. 돌기(바디 이름 LINK6_TOOL_RING 그대로) 지름 = 그리퍼 layout.recess_dia · 높이 = recess_depth · 플랜지 인서트 구멍 넷 지름 = 원장 insert_hole_dia · 원 = arm_screw_pcd · 각 = arm_screw_phase_deg(링크 6 지역 y 에서 z 쪽) · 깊이 = screws.arm_m3.length − (base_top − arm_screw_cbore[1]) + screw_hole_extra_depth — 숫자는 그 두 파일에만 둔다

cap_slash.shift_note: J4's end cap faces the forearm bar (link 3, y -62 .. -18): the slash moves 6 mm toward +y so no part of it is buried in the bar

logo.face: -y (toward the J2 output side, seen from the front)
logo.note: KMJH letters drawn by the author from the user's brand image as polygons (kmjh_logo.py) - not an original logo file

marks.hub_caps: navy disc (1.0 proud, radius = hub radius - hub chamfer - 2) + mint slash on the outer faces of the shoulder, elbow and wrist hubs
marks.bar_end_cut: forearm and wrist bars end beside the next joint's motor can: the part outside the can is cut at 45 deg (meets the can inside radius RC - 0.5)

notes: Exterior bodies are solid envelopes like v2: wall thickness, cavities, fasteners and reducers are not designed here.
Joint origins, axes, link lengths, drum diameters/depth, can radius and the display pose are v1/v2 values (unchanged) - only edge shapes, link cross-sections, colors and marks change.
v2 files (models/armold-mks-product-v2, src/cad/armold-mks-product-v2) are pinned by Codex's alignment checks and are not modified.
